enchantments.tooltip: Feather Falling: This item is engraved with feathers and bestows a powerful magical effect. Whenever the wearer begins to fall from any height, this effect slows the descent dramatically, causing the wearer to fall like a feather.
Underwater Action: This item grants the wearer the ability to breathe water as if it were air.
Whirlwind Absorption: This effect absorbs air elementals knockdown attack.
